Question_text: A student pulls a piece of tape through a ticker-tape timer. Every 0.02 s, the timer prints a dot on the tape. First the tape is pulled quickly, then slowly, then quickly again. Which piece of tape does the student obtain?
image: An illustration of a ticker-tape timer setup, which marks dots on a moving paper tape at regular time intervals. Below the setup, four strips of tape (A, B, C, D) are shown, each displaying a different pattern of dot spacing. Option A shows dots that are initially widely spaced (fast), then become uniformly closer (slower), then become uniformly wider spaced again (faster). Option B shows dots that are initially widely spaced, then become very closely spaced (very slow), then become widely spaced again. Option C shows dots that are initially widely spaced, then gradually become closer, then gradually wider. Option D shows dots that are initially widely spaced, then become closer together, then remain relatively close but uniform.
